title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime Adds 2 More Cast Members
content:
The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series revealed the anime's second "situation visual" and two additional cast members on Tuesday.

The newly announced cast members are:

Tomoyo Takayanagi as Neil Liston, Nia's brother

Yūki Urushiyama as Lynette Blanc, Neil's maid and guard

J-Novel Club releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different...But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she's got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she's in fighting form. Now that she's been given a second shot at life, however, she's determined to get what she wants. She's going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

The anime stars:

• Honoka Inoue as Nia Liston

• Fūka Izumi as Rinokis Funk

• Rina Honnizumi as Hildetora Altoir

• Rina Hidaka as Reliared Silver

• Taku Yashiro as Anzel

• Yōko Hikasa as Fressa

• Satoshi Hino as Gandolf Rogen

• Kōichi Sakaguchi as Bendelio

• Junichi Suwabe as Hyurence Altoire

• Maaya Uchida as Sharro White

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Asuma

Motoki Nakanishi ( Love Is Indivisible by Twins , Summoned to Another World for a Second Time ) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation with Haruta Segi as the assistant director. Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , PuniRunes three seasons) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Itō ( Mob Psycho 100 II OAV key animator) and Kana Tosaoka ( Kantai Collection -KanColle- film in-between animator) are designing the characters. Naoki Endō ( Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Nijiyon Animation ) is composing the music, and Hiromi Kikuta ( Aikatsu! , Blue Period , Haikyu!! ) is directing the sound. VTuber Tsunomaki Watame performs the opening theme song "Respawn!!."

The additional staff members are:

• Color Key Artist: Ryōta Katsuta, Maki Yamamoto

• Art Setting: Barnstorm Design Labo

• Art Director: Hiroshi Gōroku

• Background Art: Makaria

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takashi Ōde

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

The anime will premiere on October 6 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST, then on the BS NTV , and MBS channels, and will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The anime will also stream on ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT after its broadcast. HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs. The anime will also hold an advance screening event for its first three episodes on September 22 at the esports TOKYO BAY studio.

Minamino launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, and ended its run there in 2021. Hobby Japan started publishing the novels with illustration by Jishaku in September 2022. Katana Canata started drawing the novels' illustration from its third volume in 2023. (The anime credits both illustrators for the original character designs.) Hobby Japan will published the 12th volume on October 1.

Kabuto Kodai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service in 2022. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2023, and will publish the ninth volume on October 7. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season's 2nd Part Unveils Theme Songs in New Video
content:
The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, started streaming the main promotional video and announced the theme songs for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday. The video previews the opening theme song "NEVER SAY NEVER AGAIN" by the rock band GLAY . The duo of artists Masayoshi Ōishi and Tom-H@ck called OxT performs the ending theme song "ROAD TO BE BLUE."

The main cast returned for the current season. New cast member Daisuke Sakuma will voice Shinichiro Saotome from Inashiro High School.

Hideaki Ōba ( Kunon the Sorcerer Can See , I'm in Love with the Villainess , Love of Kill ) is the season's director, replacing Mitsuyuki Masuhara , at OLM ( Madhouse animated Ace of Diamond Act II ). Kenji Konuta is returning from the previous three anime in the franchise to oversee the series scripts. Yasukazu Shōji ( Major 2nd chief animation director, Restaurant to Another World (TV 2) character designer) is the current character designer, replacing Minoru Ueda and Satoshi Tasaki . Hajime Hyakkoku is returning from Ace of Diamond Act II to compose the music.

The Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season anime premiered on April 5 on TV Tokyo and its affiliates, and also on AT-X . The anime is also streaming on Netflix in Japan.

Terajima launched the Ace of Diamond manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2006. He ended the manga in January 2015, and Kodansha published 47 volumes for the manga. Terajima then launched Ace of Diamond Act II in August 2015, and ended the manga in October 2022. Kodansha published 34 volumes for the sequel manga.

Mad Cave Studios' Nakama Press imprint has licensed the manga and will release it as Ace of the Diamond in English in a 3-in-1 omnibus format, starting with the first omnibus volume on March 23, 2027.

Terajima's original Ace of Diamond baseball manga inspired a television anime that premiered in 2013, and Crunchyroll streamed the 75-episode series as it aired in Japan. Ace of Diamond: Second Season premiered in April 2015, and Crunchyroll also streamed the 51-episode series as it aired.

The Ace of Diamond Act II anime premiered in April 2019 and aired for 52 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

The Ace of Diamond manga won the shōnen category of the 34th Kodansha Manga Awards in 2010. Kodansha USA Publishing began releasing the manga digitally in English in March 2017 under the title Ace of the Diamond . K MANGA is releasing the Ace of the Diamond Act II manga in English.

The manga has also inspired a series of stage plays.

title: Julius Faces Reid Again in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 17 Preview
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 17 (Episode 83 overall) preview ahead of its September 16, 2026 premiere. This will be the sixth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc . The first part of the anime dominated our Spring 2026 awards , winning a total of 19 awards, while the anime ranked sixth in the latest weekly ranking after Episode 16. Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

You can watch the preview trailer for the sixteenth episode below.

ALSO READ: Re:ZERO Season 4 Director Reveals Unblurred Image of Rem Scene From Episode 13

The title of the episode is “Good Loser,” and the synopsis is described: With his two sets of memories merged, Subaru is finally reunited with Emilia and the others. He assigns his companions to confront the five crises closing in on the tower, and an all-out battle begins to put an end to the loop of death.

Also check out the preview images:

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton Game Delayed to 2027
content:
The staff for Shueisha Games and poncle's Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton game announced on Tuesday that the game's release has been delayed to 2027. The game's staff said that the delay is to delivery a satisfying game. The game also started streaming a second trailer with the new 2027 release date.

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam , and was initially slated for release this year.

The survivor royale action game supports 1-8 players.

Players can control over 20 characters from the series, who use their signature abilities and Domain Expansions. In each game, players compete against each other to fight cursed spirits for points. The game also features "Rule Additions" similar to the series' Culling Game. Each match features randomized skills.

Gege Akutami launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in March 2018, and ended it in September 2024. Viz Media is publishing the manga digitally and in print, and Shueisha is also publishing the manga digitally on its MANGA Plus service.

The first Jujutsu Kaisen television anime season premiered in October 2020, and it had 24 episodes.

The Jujutsu Kaisen 0 anime film opened in Japan in December 2021, and it opened with English subtitles and with an English dub in the U.S. and Canada in March 2022. The film got revival screenings in five cities across Japan in October 2025.

The second season premiered in July 2023 on MBS and TBS and 28 affiliated channels. Crunchyroll streamed the second season as it aired in Japan and also streamed an English dub . The second season aired for two cours (quarters of a year) for a continuous half-year run.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1 , the first part of the third season of the anime, premiered with the first two episodes as a one-hour special on January 8 on the "Super Animeism TURBO" programming block on MBS , TBS , and their affiliates. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, excluding Asia. The first part's final episode aired as an extended 27-minute episode on March 26.

title: Yuka Ōshima's 'Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~' Manga Gets Short TV Anime
content:
A short-format television anime adaptation of Yuka Ōshima's Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~ (Haru and Gen: Raising a Child for the First Time at 70) manga will premiere next January on the TV Kanagawa (tvk) channel.

The manga's story centers on Gen, a 70-year-old man who was estranged by his wife and daughter after a divorce many years ago. After his daughter's death, he has been entrusted to take care of his three-year-old granddaughter Haru. Having neglected his family in the past, Gen now faces the challenge of raising a child for the first time, along with its unexpected twists and turns.

Kōdai Satō ( Tom to Jerry Gokko ) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio in collaboration with Studio Nanahoshi . Taeko Miura ( Kanagawa Elves , Hyakki Yakou Shou ) is directing the sound, Maki Takuma ( After-School Hanako-kun , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club ) is in charge of sound effects, and bermei.inazawa ( Potion, Waga Mi o Tasukeru , Marukano ) is composing the music. RD is in charge of sound production, and Kazuya Takahashi ( Love and Lies , Saiyuki Reload Blast ) is the executive producer.

Ōshima launched the manga on Kadokawa 's TATESC Comic vertical-scrolling, full-color webcomic label in December 2022. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in March 2024.

title: Funbarus Posture Support Plush Toys Get Short TV Anime
content:
Manufacturing company Dreams announced on Tuesday that its Funbarus posture support plush toy series is inspiring a short anime that will premiere on October 3 on the BS Yoshimoto channel at 11:25 p.m. JST (10:25 a.m. EDT), and on Tokyo MX on October 5 at 9:54 p.m. The company also announced the anime's cast and staff members, and its "image song" by hip hop group Ketsumeishi titled "Kimi ni BUMP."

The two-minute short anime uses a new "2D x AI hybrid" animation production process. The production creates the key animation drawings based on the planning documents, storyboards, and character and art designs via existing traditional 2D animation techniques. The production then uses 3D CG and "AI digital techniques" to generate the animation sequences.

The anime centers on Nossori the sloth, who always works hard for humans and idly listens to their casual conversations. Those conversations in turn, fuel Nossori's wild imagination.

The anime will star:

Wataru Komada as Nossori, a laid-back Sloth who loves daydreaming

Kōtarō Nishiyama as Montan, an energetic and cheerful monkey

Sayuri Hara as Hop, a reliable, strong-willed, and big-sister-type rabbit

The anime will also star (image above from top left to bottom right):

• Kenta Miyake as Brownie the Bear

• Kento Shiraishi as Pentan the Penguin

• Hayato Kimura as Shaomaru the Panda

• Ai (from the comedy duo Yoneda 2000) as Johnny the Duck

• Hiroaki Tajiri as Zūzū the Koala

Additional cast members are:

• Kōki Miyata as Kuromitsu

• Mitsuhiro Sakamaki as Fairy

• Nanami Yamashita as Nyanti

• Madoka Asahina as Nuts

• Shiho Hisajima as Narrator

Voicing the humans are Shotaro Uzawa , Taiga Takano , Nene Hieda , and Makoto from the comedy duo Yoneda 2000.

Kazumi Nonaka ( Mameushi-kun , Hana Kappa , ATASHIn'CHI Next ) is directing the anime at MI Co., and Takeshi Takemura ( I Love Me , Mrs. Warabi ) is writing the scripts. Ryu Kawasaki ( Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!! ) is composing the music, and 81 Produce is presenting the project.

The Funbarus posture support plush toys launched in 2023. To help prevent people from hunching over desks or tables, they can place these toys between the desk and their stomachs.

title: Nintendo Hosts Switch Event in India
content:
Nintendo hosted a Nintendo Switch event in India on September 5-6 at R City Mall in Mumbai. The event let players watch and try demos of:

• Nintendo Switch Sports

• Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

• Super Mario Bros. Wonder

• The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

The event did not include Nintendo 's latest console the Switch 2 (pictured right).

A volunteer at the event stated to IGN India that while "it would be far fetched to say that they are officially entering [the Indian market], right now they are just testing the waters."

In a similar move, Bushiroad hosted its Bushiroad Expo 2025 exhibition at Jio World Center during Mumbai Comic-Con in April 2025. The representatives of the company had stated to ANN that the exhibition was all Indian fans could look forward to for the time being, but that the company was looking to build a presence in the country and was looking into interest from audiences, licensors, and retailers.

Nintendo recently filed a suit against a Patna-based real estate company for using the name " Nintendo ." The Hindu reported on August 9 that The Delhi High Court had restrained the real estate company from using the name, stating that it infringes the trademark rights of Nintendo Co. Ltd.

title: Spin-off Manga 'Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER' Concludes 18-Year Serialization
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Monday that the Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER spin-off manga will end with its 200th and final chapter in the issue releasing on December 25.

Akane began serializing the four-panel comedy manga, based on Bandai-Namco 's The iDOLM@STER franchise, in Dengeki Maoh in July 2008. Kadokawa published the 15th volume in December 2024, with the 16th and final volume scheduled for a February 2027 release.

A 64-episode net anime adapatation streamed from January to March 2013. A 74-episode sequel streamed between April to June 2014.

The Fuyu→Kotatsu←Haru original video anime (OVA) was released in March 2014. The tenth and 11th limited edition volumes of the manga also included two OVA episodes in March and November 2018.

The original television anime produced by A-1 Pictures premiered in Summer 2011, followed by a special episode and three OVAs in June and October 2012, respectively. The iDOLM@STER: Kagayaki no Mukougawa e! ( The iDOLM@STER: Beyond the Brilliant Future ) anime movie opened in Japan in January 2014.

title: We Are Aliens Film's New Trailer Highlights Heroine Konatsu
content:
NOTHING NEW unveiled a new trailer and visual for its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film with director Kōhei Kadowaki on Tuesday. Both the trailer and visual highlight the heroine Konatsu.

We Are Aliens centers on Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, two boys who as elementary school students became close friends, but jealousy and misunderstandings eventually drove them apart. Years have passed and the two boys have gone in different directions in life. But when the memories from their past come back, they must face what happened between them years ago.

The film stars Ryōta Bandō ( Fureru. , live-action How to Train Your Dragon's Japanese dub ) as Tsubasa, and Amane Okayama ( Blue Giant , live-action I''s , Hirayasumi ) as Gyōtarō, when both characters are young adults. Child actors Yūto Maki and Tasuku Nakagome — who were both selected through auditions — voice Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, respectively, when they were younger. Other cast members include Sakurazaka46 idol group member Ten Yamasaki as Konatsu, comedian Kemuri Matsui as Batahara, Gaku Sano as Tsubasa's friend Seiya Toda, Reika Ōzeki as young Seiya, Arisa Sasaki as Toda's friend Elmo Matsushita, and Edo Harumi as a calligraphy teacher.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle , who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others, composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the upcoming film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025. adieu performs the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split).

The film will open in Japan on September 25. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. The Ottawa International Film Festival (OIAF), the Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF), and New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF) are screening the film. OIAF takes place from September 23-27, MIFF took place from August 6-23, and NZIFF took place from July 29-August 9. The film will screen in the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), which will take place on October 6-15

Sales company CHARADES licensed the film to the distributors Hooray Films in Taiwan, Shaw Organisation in Singapore, Intercontinental Film Distributors in Hong Kong, and Sahamongkol Film in Thailand. CHARADES is handling international sales of the film.

The staff launched a crowdfunding campaign in November 2025 on the Motion Gallery website. The campaign aimed to cover production and advertising costs, specifically to "improve the quality of the work" and to "distribute the film more widely." The campaign ended on March 2 and exceeded its 8 million yen (about US$50,365) target and raised 9,604,510 (about US$60,467) yen.

NOTHING NEW is a small film company that was founded in 2022 with the aim "to create a world where talent is not crushed."

title: Silent Hill f Game Gets Manga Based on Fox Mask Character
content:
Famitsu.com announced on September 9 that Silent Hill f , the recent spinoff game in the franchise, will get a new manga adaptation focused on the Fox Mask character in the Weekly Famitsu magazine in late 2026.

The story is supervised by the game's original writer Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) and Konami . The manga will have two separate parts, with the first part depicting the origin story of Fox Mask. New artist Ayato will draw the manga.

The Silent Hill f game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on September 25, 2025. The game had exceeded 1 million units in cumulative worldwide shipments, as of September 26. The cumulative total includes physical copies and digital downloads of the game.

Ryukishi07 ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) wrote the story, and kera designed the creatures and characters. Motoi Okamoto produced the game, and Neobards Entertainment ( Resident Evil Re:Verse ) developed the game.

Ame Gōkin launched a manga adaptation with a new ending from Ryukishi07 on Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up manga website on April 22.

Annapurna Interactive's Silent Hill: Townfall game will launch on PlayStation 5 on September 24. The game will also launch on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.
